verdict.rationale: Cline's own provider lets a developer sign in once and pick models without managing separate vendor API keys. Free access is documented only as periodic free-model promotions with a limited usage quota; otherwise the sign-in path relies on paid credits or a subscription, so a standing free tier is not shown. Missing for 10: a documented permanent free tier tied to the signed-in account, details of the free quota and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sign-in free-access flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys

citations.quote: Instead of managing separate API keys across multiple vendors, you sign in once, add Cline credits, and select from available models directly in Cline.
Cline periodically offers free model promotions that let you try select models at no cost, up to a limited usage quota.
